title: Sequential Estimation of Dynamic Discrete Choice Models with Unobserved Heterogeneity
abstract: arXiv:2604.26205v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Unobserved heterogeneity is empirically central in dynamic discrete choice models but computationally costly to incorporate: estimation requires repeatedly solving fixed-point equations for every latent type. We develop EM-NPL($q$), a unified framework combining the sequential pseudo-likelihood (NPL) and finite-mixture Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithms, truncating the inner solver to $q$ iterations, and accommodating the Bellman, policy valuation, Euler, and Efficient Pseudo-Likelihood (EPL) equations, with step-by-step implementation guidance. For linear-in-parameters models estimated via the policy valuation or EPL equations, we establish truncation invariance: for any $q\geq 1$, EM-NPL($q$) is numerically identical to the fully converged EM-NPL estimator, so q affects computation but not statistical properties. translated_title: 具有不可观测异质性的动态离散选择模型的序贯估计
translated_abstract: 不可观测异质性在动态离散选择模型中具有经验研究上的核心地位，但将其纳入模型的计算成本高昂：估计过程需要对每个潜在类型反复求解不动点方程。我们开发了EM-NPL(q)，这是一个将序贯伪似然(NPL)算法与有限混合期望最大化(EM)算法相结合的统一框架，它将内部求解器截断至q次迭代，并可适用于Bellman方程、策略估值方程、Euler方程和有效伪似然(EPL)方程，同时提供逐步实施指导。对于通过策略估值方程或EPL方程估计的参数线性模型，我们建立了截断不变性：对于任意q≥1，EM-NPL(q)在数值上与完全收敛的EM-NPL估计量完全相同，因此q只影响计算而不影响统计性质。我们建立了一致性、渐近正态性和局部收敛性。截断可使运行时间最多减少26%……
tldr: 本文提出EM-NPL(q)统一框架，将序贯伪似然与有限混合EM算法相结合以估计含不可观测异质性的动态离散选择模型，并证明对于参数线性模型，截断内层求解器迭代的估计量与完全收敛的估计量在数值上完全相同，从而在不影响统计性质的前提下最多减少26%的运行时间。
en_tdlr: This paper develops EM-NPL(q), a unified framework combining NPL and finite-mixture EM algorithms for estimating dynamic discrete choice models with unobserved heterogeneity, and establishes truncation invariance: for linear-in-parameters models, the truncated estimator is numerically identical to the fully converged one, cutting runtime by up to 26% without affecting statistical properties.
